newsitem.title: HUNGARY: BASKETBALL-LITHUANIA WIN WOMEN'S EUROPEAN TITLE.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-LITHUANIA WIN WOMEN'S EUROPEAN TITLE.

text.p: Lithuania beat Slovakia 72-62 in a tense battle to win the European women's basketball championship on Sunday.
Both teams concentrated on defence in the opening minutes but Slovakia soon began a powerful offensive which put them six points ahead by the 16th minute.
The Lithuanians produced a determined response. They finished the first half with a one-point edge and stretched their advantage in the second half.
With time running out, Slovakia pushed harder but failed to find any holes in a tight Lithuanian defence.
The battle for third place between Germany and Hungary was less balanced as the physically and tactically superior German team ensured a comfortable 86-61 victory.

The gap could have been wider if the Germans, revelling in a 30-point lead midway through the second half, had maintained the momentum against a Hungarian side still licking their wounds after Saturday's beating by Slovakia.
